package fixture

import "testing"

type fakeClock struct{ now int }

func (c *fakeClock) Advance(n int) { c.now += n }

type fakeBench struct {
	clock *fakeClock
	done  bool
}

func TestFixtureFakeBenchAndClock(t *testing.T) {
	b := fakeBench{clock: &fakeClock{}}
	b.clock.Advance(5)
	b.done = true
	if !b.done {
		t.Fatal("the event never arrived")
	}
}
